name: 77scenarios-prerender
description: Local build tooling for 77scenarios.com. Pre-renders the client-side template routes into static HTML for crawlers and no-JS users, then regenerates the sitemap from disk. Output is committed to the repo; Vercel has no build step.

scripts.lang: node scripts/i18n/apply.mjs es && node scripts/i18n/apply.mjs ja && node scripts/noindex-langs.mjs && node scripts/ads-policy.mjs
